Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd., based at No.136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China, is a prominent player in the chemical industry renowned for specializing in the production and development of silicone materials and other specialty chemicals. Established with a vision to transcend in chemical innovation, Runhe has been at the forefront of delivering high-quality, environmentally friendly chemical solutions tailored for various industrial applications. Their product spectrum largely focuses on silicone oils, silicone emulsions, and silicone surfactants, which are crucial in cosmetic, textile, agricultural, and construction sectors, among others.

As an enterprise deeply anchored in technological advancement and sustainability, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. leverages state-of-the-art research and development facilities to foster product innovations that meet the dynamic demands of its global clientele. The company's commitment to sustainability is evident in its processes and products which aim to decrease environmental impact and enhance efficiency across various user industries.

Their strategic location in the economically vibrant province of Zhejiang facilitates not only robust logistic advantages but also proximity to pivotal markets and raw material sources, enhancing their operational efficiencies and market responsiveness. Through continuous investment in technology, sustainable practices, and an unwavering commitment to quality, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. aspires to expand its footprint in the international chemical markets, building trustworthy and lasting relationships with its customers. This foundational ethos drives their pursuit for excellence and innovation in the complex world of chemical manufacturing.
